blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday urged military leaders to be “competent, fair and mindful” as they continue to respond to the needs of Filipinos and defend the country’s sovereign rights. He made the call as he administered the oath of office to Gen. Antonio G. Nafarrete, chief of staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), and 33 other newly promoted generals and flag officers of the AFP in a ceremony at Malacañang.
